Paxgene RIN Issue

Christopher Jin

2023-01-10

Preparing variables for analysis

We created new columns for flagged_sample (based on pain, swelling, bruising, etc during collection), calculated freeze time, ethnicity, age group bins, and BMI for PCA analysis. These are variables that might relate to variation in gene expression.

MOP-flagged samples

The RNA-seq pipeline manual of procedures (MOP) defines a flagged sample (e.g., potentially problematic) as a sample that satisfies one of the following: (1) number of read pairs \(<20M\), (2) percent GC not in \([20,80]\), (3) percent rRNA reads \(>20\), (4) percent of uniquely mapped reads \(<60\), (5) RIN \(<6\), and (6) percent coding reads + percent utr reads \(< 50\).

Dataset normalization through TMM

We first remove unexpressed genes using the min_cpm and min_num_samples parameters. We then use edgeR for library size correction and for TMM normalization. For each dataset (i.e., tissue) we store the normalized data table and all additional variables (e.g., clinical data) in a list called norm_rnaseq_data.

min_cpm = 0.5
min_num_samples_pct = 0.1
norm_method="TMM"
# Specify how many PCs to examine
num_pcs = 5
num_pcs_for_outlier_analysis = 3
# Specify the significance level for association analysis
# (e.g., between a PC and a clinical variable)
p_thr = 0.0001
norm_rnaseq_data = list()
for (tissue in c('muscle_data','blood_data')) {
  unnorm_counts = rna_seq_data[[tissue]] #ref standards are in here
  curr_samples = as.character(colnames(unnorm_counts)) 
  norm_counts = edgeR_normalized_log_cpm(as.matrix(unnorm_counts),
                                         min_cpm = min_cpm,
                                         min_num_samples = round(length(unnorm_counts)*min_num_samples_pct),
                                         norm_method = norm_method
  )
  curr_meta1 = rna_seq_data$rnaseq_meta[curr_samples,]
  curr_meta2 = rna_seq_data$pheno_data[curr_samples,]
  curr_meta <- cbind(curr_meta1,curr_meta2)
  norm_rnaseq_data[[tissue]] = list(
    norm_counts = norm_counts,
    raw_counts = unnorm_counts[rownames(unnorm_counts) %in% rownames(norm_counts),],
    metadata = curr_meta)
}

Batch correction

var = 'RINcut'

blood_pcas$PID<-NULL

library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridis)
## Loading required package: viridisLite
library(pheatmap)
pca_conds = c('pca_w_rin', 'pca_no_rin')
for (cond in pca_conds){
  blood_pcas = cbind(norm_rnaseq_data[['blood_data']][[cond]],norm_rnaseq_data[['blood_data']]$metadata)
  form <- ~ PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4 + PC5 + RIN + Lib_DNA_conc + reads + r_260_280 + r_260_230 + pct_rRNA + pct_globin + pct_coding + pct_chrAuto + pct_umi_dup + median_5_3_bias + Batch + pct_multimapped + pct_GC + pct_chrM + clinical_site + age + temporal_sampling_profile + pre_or_post_visit + randomGroupCode + timepointDescription + Ethnicity + BMI + Sex + coll_staffid + blood_freezetime + Lib_RNA_conc
  # Blood:
  # Compute Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) between all pairs of variables
  # returns absolute correlation value
  C_blood = canCorPairs(form, blood_pcas)
  rownames(C_blood) <- c("PC1","PC2","PC3","PC4","PC5","RIN","DNA Conc.", "N reads", "260/280", "260/230","rRNA","Globlin","Coding","chrAuto",'Duplicates',
                         '5-3 bias', 'Batch','Multimapped','GC','chrM','Clinical site','Age','Sampling','Post intervention', 'Intervention', 'Timepoint',
                         'Ethnicity','BMI','Sex','Staff','Freeze time', 'Lib_RNA_conc')
  
  colnames(C_blood) <- c("PC1","PC2","PC3","PC4","PC5","RIN","DNA Conc.", "N reads", "260/280", "260/230","rRNA","Globlin","Coding","chrAuto",'Duplicates',
                         '5-3 bias', 'Batch','Multimapped','GC','chrM','Clinical site','Age','Sampling','Post intervention', 'Intervention', 'Timepoint',
                         'Ethnicity','BMI','Sex','Staff','Freeze time', 'Lib_RNA_conc')
  # Plot correlation matrix
  coul <- brewer.pal(9, "Reds") 
  pcs <- c("PC1","PC2","PC3","PC4","PC5")
  breaksList = seq(0, 1.00, by = 0.1)
  pheatmap(C_blood[!rownames(C_blood) %in% pcs,pcs],color=coul,breaks=breaksList,fontsize = 14, cluster_cols = F,main = paste(cond,"CCA"))
}

Differential analysis between refs - Split by gender

blood_only = norm_rnaseq_data$blood_data
refs_blood = rownames(blood_only$metadata[blood_only$metadata$is_ref == 'True',])
# filt counts 
counts = blood_only[['raw_counts']]  #remember that the counts matrix is cols not rows 

# remove outliers 
meta = blood_only[['metadata']] 
meta$RIN = ifelse(is.na(meta$RIN), mean(meta$RIN, na.rm = T), meta$RIN)
median_bloods_refs_rin = median(na.omit(blood_only[['metadata']][refs_blood,]$RIN))
meta$group = ifelse(meta$SampleTypeCode=='f-paxgene rna'& meta$RIN < median_bloods_refs_rin, "f_lowrins", "") #set the first test occurance to empty
meta$group = ifelse(meta$SampleTypeCode=='f-paxgene rna'& meta$RIN > median_bloods_refs_rin, "f_highrins", meta$group)

meta$group = ifelse(meta$SampleTypeCode=='m-paxgene rna'& meta$RIN < median_bloods_refs_rin, "m_lowrins", meta$group)
meta$group = ifelse(meta$SampleTypeCode=='m-paxgene rna'& meta$RIN > median_bloods_refs_rin, "m_highrins", meta$group)

#Number of samples in ea group: f-lowrins: 4, f-highrins: 2, m_lowrins = 5, m_highrins = 8

curr_meta = as.data.frame(meta) #1,062 entries, 328 total columns

message("Performing differential analysis for ...")
## Performing differential analysis for ...
full = paste0(c("~ 0", "Sex", "Batch", "group"), collapse=" + ")
full_w_rin = paste0(c("~ 0", "Sex", "Batch", "group", "RIN"), collapse=" + ")
#So we can't include age_groups as a covariate if we're including the ref stnds, unless we want to assign a random age group for the ref stnds. 

# normalize and get voom weights 
design = stats::model.matrix(eval(parse(text=full)), data = curr_meta)
design_w_rin = stats::model.matrix(eval(parse(text=full_w_rin)), data = curr_meta)

counts <- counts[,colnames(counts) %in% rownames(design)] #trim samples that aren't in the meta sheet (this is bc of missing RIN....)


voom_res = limma::voom(counts, normalize.method = "quantile", design = design)

fit = limma::lmFit(voom_res, design)
fit_w_rin = limma::lmFit(voom_res, design_w_rin)

#contrasts based on the
cont.matrix = limma::makeContrasts(
  'male' = "groupm_lowrins - groupm_highrins",
  'female' = "groupf_lowrins - groupf_highrins",
  levels = design)
cont_with_rin.matrix = limma::makeContrasts(
  'male' = "groupm_lowrins - groupm_highrins",
  'female' = "groupf_lowrins - groupf_highrins",
  levels = design_w_rin)

fit2 = limma::contrasts.fit(fit,cont.matrix)
fit2_w_rin = limma::contrasts.fit(fit_w_rin,cont_with_rin.matrix)
e = limma::eBayes(fit2)
e_w_rin = limma::eBayes(fit2_w_rin)

DA Figure for the male ref standards, split for visualization purposes.

da_list_m = list()
#adjusted p_value at 0.1 bc frankly 0.05 gave <10 for each gender...
res = limma::topTable(e, number=nrow(e), coef='male', confint=TRUE)
res_w_rin = limma::topTable(e_w_rin, number=nrow(e_w_rin), coef='male', confint=TRUE)

dt = data.table::data.table(
  feature_ID = rownames(res),
  logFC = res$logFC,
  logFC_se = (res$CI.R - res$CI.L)/3.92, 
  tscore = res$t,
  p_value = res$P.Value
)
dt[,adj_p_value := p.adjust(p_value, method="BH")]
dt[,colour := ifelse(adj_p_value < 0.1, "red", "black")]

dt_w_rin = data.table::data.table(
  feature_ID = rownames(res_w_rin),
  logFC = res_w_rin$logFC,
  logFC_se = (res_w_rin$CI.R - res_w_rin$CI.L)/3.92, 
  tscore = res_w_rin$t,
  p_value = res_w_rin$P.Value
)
dt_w_rin[,adj_p_value := p.adjust(p_value, method="BH")]
dt_w_rin[,colour := ifelse(adj_p_value < 0.1, "red", "black")]

# volcano plot 
g = ggplot(dt, aes(y=-log10(p_value), x=logFC, colour=colour)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed", colour="black") +
  theme_bw() +

g_w_rin = ggplot(dt_w_rin, aes(y=-log10(p_value), x=logFC, colour=colour)) +

Investigating - RIN vs Gene Length / GC Content / Gene expression level

names_un_5 = rownames(norm_rnaseq_data$blood_data$metadata[norm_rnaseq_data$blood_data$metadata$RIN < 5,])
names_ab_8 = rownames(norm_rnaseq_data$blood_data$metadata[norm_rnaseq_data$blood_data$metadata$RIN > 8,])
sig_genes_refs = dt %>% dplyr::filter(adj_p_value < .1)
genes_adj_in_refs = sig_genes_refs$feature_ID

mart <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
genes <- rownames(counts)
gene_info <- getBM(mart, attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id_version", "transcript_length", "percentage_gene_gc_content"),
                   filters = "ensembl_gene_id_version", values = genes, useCache = F)
conds = c("batch_corrected_w_RIN","batch_corrected_no_RIN")
# Use the counts matrix from the blood_data element of norm_rnaseq_data, with batch correction but no RIN correction
for (condition in conds){
  counts = norm_rnaseq_data[["blood_data"]][[condition]]
  
  metadata <- norm_rnaseq_data[["blood_data"]]$metadata
  
  # Calculate the mean RIN value for each sample
  sample_ids <- colnames(counts)
  missing_rin <- is.na(metadata$RIN[match(sample_ids, rownames(metadata))])
  
  # Subset the metadata and counts matrix to remove the samples with missing RIN values
  metadata <- metadata[!missing_rin, ]
  counts <- counts[, !missing_rin]
  
  sample_ids <- colnames(counts)
  rin <- metadata$RIN[match(sample_ids, rownames(metadata))]
  
  # Define the window width
  window_width <- 0.2
  var = NULL
  
  # Create a vector of RIN values to use as the rolling window index
  rin_range <- seq(min(rin), max(rin), by = window_width)
  
  # Calculate the variance of gene expression for each RIN group
  var_values <- tapply(apply(counts, 2, var), rin, mean)
  
  plot(rin, apply(counts, 2, var), pch = 20, xlab = "RIN value", ylab = "Variance of gene expression")
  points(unique(rin), var_values, col = "red", pch = 20)
  legend("topleft", legend = c("Variance", "Variance by RIN"), col = c("black", "red"), pch = 20)
  title(main = condition)
}

for (condition in conds){
  counts = norm_rnaseq_data[["blood_data"]][[condition]]
  counts_un_5 = counts[,colnames(counts) %in% names_un_5]
  counts_ab_8 = counts[,colnames(counts) %in% names_ab_8]
  counts_only_sig_u5 = rowMeans(counts_un_5[(rownames(counts_un_5) %in% genes_adj_in_refs),])
  counts_only_sig_a8 = rowMeans(counts_ab_8[(rownames(counts_ab_8) %in% genes_adj_in_refs),])
  mean_exp_df <- data.frame(Gene = names(counts_only_sig_u5),
                            RIN_u5 = counts_only_sig_u5,
                            RIN_a8 = counts_only_sig_a8)
  # Create the scatter plot using ggplot2
  p1 <- ggplot(mean_exp_df, aes(x = RIN_u5, y = RIN_a8)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    xlab("Mean expression in RIN < 5") +
    ylab("Mean expression in RIN > 8") +
    ggtitle(paste(condition, "Gene outliers in ref stnds - Mean gene expression in RIN < 5 and RIN > 8 samples"))
  p1 <- p1 + stat_cor(method = "pearson")
  p1 <- p1 + lims(x = c(0, max(mean_exp_df$RIN_u5, mean_exp_df$RIN_a8)),
                y = c(0, max(mean_exp_df$RIN_u5, mean_exp_df$RIN_a8)))
  
  counts_only_sig_u5 = apply((counts_un_5[(rownames(counts_un_5) %in% genes_adj_in_refs),]), 1, var)
  counts_only_sig_a8 = apply((counts_ab_8[(rownames(counts_ab_8) %in% genes_adj_in_refs),]), 1, var)
  mean_exp_df <- data.frame(Gene = names(counts_only_sig_u5),
                            RIN_u5 = counts_only_sig_u5,
                            RIN_a8 = counts_only_sig_a8)
  # Create the scatter plot using ggplot2
  p2 <- ggplot(mean_exp_df, aes(x = RIN_u5, y = RIN_a8)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    xlab("Mean variance in RIN < 5") +
    ylab("Mean variance in RIN > 8") +
    ggtitle(paste(condition, "Gene outliers in ref stnds - Mean gene variance in RIN < 5 and RIN > 8 samples"))
  p2 <- p2 + stat_cor(method = "pearson")
  p2 <- p2 + lims(x = c(0, max(mean_exp_df$RIN_u5, mean_exp_df$RIN_a8)),
                y = c(0, max(mean_exp_df$RIN_u5, mean_exp_df$RIN_a8)))
  grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2)
}

for (condition in conds){

  counts_w_gene_length = cbind(counts,gene_lengths_vec)
  
  counts_only_long_genes = as.data.frame(counts_w_gene_length) %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene_lengths_vec > quantile(gene_lengths_vec, 0.75, na.rm = T)) %>%

  counts_long_un_5 = rowMeans(counts_only_long_genes[,colnames(counts_only_long_genes) %in% names_un_5])
  counts_long_ab_8 = rowMeans(counts_only_long_genes[,colnames(counts_only_long_genes) %in% names_ab_8])
  
  counts_only_short_genes = as.data.frame(counts_w_gene_length) %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene_lengths_vec > quantile(gene_lengths_vec, 0.25, na.rm = T)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-gene_lengths_vec)
  counts_short_un_5 = rowMeans(counts_only_short_genes[,colnames(counts_only_short_genes) %in% names_un_5])
  counts_short_ab_8 = rowMeans(counts_only_short_genes[,colnames(counts_only_short_genes) %in% names_ab_8])

                                       RIN_a8 = counts_long_ab_8)

    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    xlab("Mean expression in RIN < 5") +
    ylab("Mean expression in RIN > 8") +
    ggtitle(paste(condition, "Long Genes - gene expression in RIN < 5 and RIN > 8 samples"))
  p1<- p1 + stat_cor(method = "pearson")
  p1 <- p1 + lims(x = c(0, max(mean_exp_long_genes_df$RIN_u5, mean_exp_long_genes_df$RIN_a8)),
                y = c(0, max(mean_exp_long_genes_df$RIN_u5, mean_exp_long_genes_df$RIN_a8)))
  
  mean_exp_short_genes_df <- data.frame(Gene = names(counts_short_un_5),

    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    xlab("Mean expression in RIN < 5") +
    ylab("Mean expression in RIN > 8") +
    ggtitle(paste(condition, "Short Genes - gene expression in RIN < 5 and RIN > 8 samples"))
  p2 <- p2 + lims(x = c(0, max(mean_exp_short_genes_df$RIN_u5, mean_exp_short_genes_df$RIN_a8)),
                y = c(0, max(mean_exp_short_genes_df$RIN_u5, mean_exp_short_genes_df$RIN_a8)))
  p2 <- p2 + stat_cor(method = "pearson")
  grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2)
}

                y = c(0, max(mean_exp_high_gc_df$RIN_u5, mean_exp_high_gc_df$RIN_a8)))
